desc:
⚡ Welcome to Battle of Alliance ⚡
Dive into the ultimate role-playing experience by transforming into your favorite giant character!

👍 Like and favorite the game to stay updated on new features and events!
🖥️ Playable on all devices — but for the smoothest experience, we recommend PC.
💬 Got feedback or want to share your clips? Join our community and show us what you've got!
✨ Join our Roblox Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/34171264

🎮 Controls
Q/E/X/C/Z/ — Hot key
T / F — Movement Key
Left Shift — Sprint
Left Alt - Shift Lock

👾 Developers
KEILGON — Lead Developer, Scripter, Animator, Builder
Leo Renders — Advisor

🚧 This game is still in Beta – expect bugs and chaotic fun!
